name: Dependency Upgrade Loop
description: Change dependencies or runtimes with environment, compatibility, CI, validation, and security gates.
approval_boundaries: Do not change package managers or runtime families without approval.
Escalate vulnerable, abandoned, or license-incompatible dependencies.

phases.name: Environment analysis
phases.instructions: Inspect manifests, lockfiles, runtime pins, and install conventions.

phases.name: Dependency review
phases.instructions: Assess upgrade, compatibility, license, and maintenance risk.

phases.name: Dependency change
phases.instructions: Apply only the source-backed manifest, lockfile, and compatibility changes.

phases.name: CI compatibility review
phases.instructions: Review pipeline runtime, cache, matrix, and packaging implications.

phases.name: Independent validation
phases.instructions: Run install, test, lint, build, and targeted compatibility checks.

phases.name: Security review
phases.instructions: Review the resulting dependency exposure and known security risk.

phases.name: Upgrade handoff
phases.instructions: Package version changes, validation, compatibility notes, and risks.
